mses-protected-estates.title: MSES - protected area (estates)
mses-protected-estates.summary: State-protected conservation areas mapped as MSES. Intersection suggests overlap with protected area estate; confirm boundaries and planning controls.
mses-protected-estates.nextSteps: Confirm against cadastre; check planning scheme and DES guidance for works near protected areas.

references.label: DES Matters of State Environmental Significance

mses-nature-refuges.title: MSES - nature refuges
mses-nature-refuges.summary: Private protected areas under conservation agreements. Overlap can affect access, disturbance, and offsets.
mses-nature-refuges.nextSteps: Identify agreement constraints and align clearing/access plans.

mses-marine-park-highly.title: MSES - marine park (highly protected)
mses-marine-park-highly.summary: Highly protected marine park zones under state marine park estate. Works and access can be tightly constrained.
mses-marine-park-highly.nextSteps: Confirm zone labels with official charts; check marine park permitting pathways.

mses-fish-habitat.title: MSES - declared fish habitat (A/B)
mses-fish-habitat.summary: Declared fish habitat areas protect fisheries and aquatic habitat. Works affecting waterways or marine plants can trigger assessment pathways.
mses-fish-habitat.nextSteps: Check fisheries and development assessment pathways; marine plant and waterway works.

mses-offset-register.title: MSES - legally secured offset (register)
mses-offset-register.summary: Areas recorded on the offset register can signal existing biodiversity commitments and land-use context.
mses-offset-register.nextSteps: Cross-check offset register records and any development conditions affecting the site.

mses-offset-vegetation.title: MSES - legally secured offset (vegetation offsets)
mses-offset-vegetation.summary: Vegetation offset areas secured for biodiversity outcomes; intersection may affect clearing and compensation framing.
mses-offset-vegetation.nextSteps: Review offset agreements and clearing/impact pathways.

mses-hev-wetland.title: MSES - high ecological value waters (wetland)
mses-hev-wetland.summary: Declared high ecological value wetlands are sensitive aquatic features.
mses-hev-wetland.nextSteps: Confirm mapping with field delineation; review wetland assessment frameworks.

mses-hes-wetlands.title: MSES - high ecological significance wetlands
mses-hes-wetlands.summary: Wetlands of high ecological significance matter for biodiversity and hydrology.
mses-hes-wetlands.nextSteps: Plan wetland delineation and hydrology impacts; consider buffers and offsets.

mses-sea-precinct.title: MSES - strategic environmental area (designated precinct)
mses-sea-precinct.summary: Strategic environmental area precincts can elevate scrutiny for certain development types in regional planning frameworks.
mses-sea-precinct.nextSteps: Align with regional plan and local planning instruments for the precinct.

mses-regveg-cat-b.title: MSES - regulated vegetation (category B)
mses-regveg-cat-b.summary: Category B (endangered or of concern RE) vegetation is highly regulated; clearing may require approvals and offsets.
mses-regveg-cat-b.nextSteps: Confirm RE mapping; vegetation survey and clearing pathways.

mses-regveg-cat-c.title: MSES - regulated vegetation (category C)
mses-regveg-cat-c.summary: Category C regulated vegetation can still trigger clearing codes and assessment depending on RE and location.
mses-regveg-cat-c.nextSteps: Confirm RE and clearing categories against the regulated vegetation management map.

mses-regveg-cat-r-gbr.title: MSES - regulated vegetation (GBR riverine)
mses-regveg-cat-r-gbr.summary: Great Barrier Reef catchment riverine category can interact with water quality and clearing rules.
mses-regveg-cat-r-gbr.nextSteps: Check GBR catchment policies and waterway buffers.

mses-regveg-essential-habitat.title: MSES - regulated vegetation (essential habitat)
mses-regveg-essential-habitat.summary: Essential habitat mapping highlights areas important for species persistence; field verification is often needed.
mses-regveg-essential-habitat.nextSteps: Cross-check species records and survey design.

mses-regveg-100m-wetland.title: MSES - regulated vegetation (100m from wetland)
mses-regveg-100m-wetland.summary: Mapped buffer around wetlands interacts with regulated vegetation rules.
mses-regveg-100m-wetland.nextSteps: Confirm wetland delineation and buffer applicability on the ground.

mses-wildlife-ev.title: MSES - wildlife habitat (endangered or vulnerable)
mses-wildlife-ev.summary: Mapped habitat for EV species triggers biodiversity and assessment attention.
mses-wildlife-ev.nextSteps: Align with species survey and impact assessment pathways.

mses-wildlife-special-lc.title: MSES - wildlife habitat (special least concern)
mses-wildlife-special-lc.summary: Special least concern animal habitat can still be material for local planning and conditions.
mses-wildlife-special-lc.nextSteps: Check local overlays and species-specific guidance.

mses-koala-core.title: MSES - SEQ koala habitat (core)
mses-koala-core.summary: SEQ koala habitat mapping signals planning and biodiversity considerations.
mses-koala-core.nextSteps: Cross-check local planning scheme; targeted survey if impacts likely.

mses-koala-refined.title: MSES - SEQ koala habitat (locally refined)
mses-koala-refined.summary: Locally refined koala habitat for local context.
mses-koala-refined.nextSteps: Align with local overlays and field survey.

mses-special-wildlife-reserves.title: MSES - special wildlife reserves
mses-special-wildlife-reserves.summary: Special wildlife reserves are high-conservation tenures with strict controls on use and access.
mses-special-wildlife-reserves.nextSteps: Confirm tenure boundaries and statutory constraints before works.

qld-fire-scar-current.title: Fire scar (historical burns)
qld-fire-scar-current.summary: Composite fire scar mapping shows where fire has been mapped on the landscape; useful context, not a forward bushfire hazard layer.
qld-fire-scar-current.nextSteps: Pair with local bushfire hazard overlays and site history; interpret alongside vegetation and access.

qld-wet-tropics-wha.title: Wet Tropics World Heritage Area
qld-wet-tropics-wha.summary: World Heritage boundaries in the Wet Tropics bioregion carry Commonwealth and state obligations for protection and assessment.
qld-wet-tropics-wha.nextSteps: If relevant, cross-check EPBC matters and Wet Tropics management provisions.

qld-world-heritage-areas.title: World heritage areas (Queensland)
qld-world-heritage-areas.summary: State-published World Heritage polygons for Queensland; use as indicative intersection with your AOI.
qld-world-heritage-areas.nextSteps: Verify against official WH boundary datasets and EPBC PMST where Commonwealth triggers may apply.

brisbane-flood-1893.title: Historical flood 1893 (Brisbane)
brisbane-flood-1893.summary: Historical flood extent for context; not a current hydraulic model or planning flood level.
brisbane-flood-1893.nextSteps: Use current flood studies and council mapping for design flood levels and planning assessment.

brisbane-flood-1974.title: Historical flood 1974 (Brisbane/Ipswich)
brisbane-flood-1974.summary: Historical flood extent for context; not a substitute for contemporary flood hazard layers.
brisbane-flood-1974.nextSteps: Cross-check FloodCheck and local government flood mapping for your site.
